width="67" x="193.5" y="950" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
actor Customer
participant \"CatalogPage (React UI)\" as UI
participant \"ProductController (Django)\" as Controller
database \"Database (PostgreSQL)\" as DB

Customer -> UI: clickOnViewAllProducts()
activate UI
UI -> Controller: getAvailableProducts()
activate Controller
Controller -> DB: SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_available = True
activate DB
DB --> Controller: return productList
deactivate DB
Controller --> UI: return HTTP 200 OK (productsJSON)
deactivate Controller
UI --> Customer: renderProductGrid(products)
deactivate UI
@enduml",
 "config": null
